scripts.build:prettier-single-line-imports: tsc -p projects/su-labs/prettier-plugin-single-line-imports/tsconfig.lib.json && cd projects/su-labs/prettier-plugin-single-line-imports && cp package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE ../../../dist/su-labs/prettier-plugin-single-line-imports/
scripts.package:vscode-ts-one-line-imports: npm run build:vscode-ts-one-line-imports && cd dist/su-labs/vscode-ts-one-line-imports && vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:theme && npm run build:notifications && npm run build:dialog && npm run build:scroll-spy && npm run build:fields && npm run build:font-size && npm run build:visit-tracker && npm run build:prettier-single-line-imports && npm run build:vscode-ts-one-line-imports
scripts.build:web: ng build web && node scripts/postbuild-site.mjs web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && rsync -a --delete dist/web/browser/ su-labs-server:/home/ubuntu/su-labs-site/ && echo "Deployed to https://su-labs.dev/"
scripts.build:games: ng build games && node scripts/postbuild-site.mjs games
scripts.deploy:games: npm run build:games && rsync -a --delete dist/games/browser/ su-labs-server:/home/ubuntu/su-labs-games/ && echo "Deployed to https://games.su-labs.dev/"
scripts.deploy:api: rsync -a --delete --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude coverage --exclude .env api/ su-labs-server:/home/ubuntu/su-labs-api/ && ssh su-labs-server 'cd /home/ubuntu/su-labs-api && docker compose up -d --build' && echo "Deployed to https://api.su-labs.dev/ and https://auth.su-labs.dev/"
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web && npm run deploy:games
scripts.backup:pull: mkdir -p backups && rsync -a su-labs-server:/home/ubuntu/su-labs-backups/ backups/ && echo "Backups copied to backups/"
